review_evidence: README identifies the repository as the Lean 4 formalization of “2-Coloring Cycles in One Round”, including matching upper and lower bounds for randomized one-round distributed cycle coloring.
The 114 current-primary Lean files include definitions, 286 theorems, 135 lemmas, API/main-result modules, and many machine-generated-looking lower-bound computation blocks.

Inspection of the small N1000000BCompressionCompute* block files shows they are proof/computation constituents of the certified lower-bound argument rather than build artifacts; generated-looking and axiom-audit files are therefore retained.
summary: Retain the complete distributed-coloring formalization, including computation blocks and audit modules; no content-lossless primary exclusion was established.
